candidates.title: Lever: Speculative LLM Inference on Smartphones
candidates.reason: Keeps a small draft model in DRAM while a larger target model resides in smartphone flash, directly combining storage-backed model offload with speculative decoding.

candidates.title: PipeSD: An Efficient Cloud-Edge Collaborative Pipeline Inference Framework with Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Pipelines cloud-edge speculative generation and verification to improve utilization and communication efficiency, directly extending heterogeneous/disaggregated LLM serving.

candidates.title: LLM-Pilot: SLO-Aware and Cost-Efficient LLM Serving on Public Cloud VM Clusters via Offloading
candidates.reason: Directly targets SLO-aware public-cloud LLM serving via offloading and cost-efficient VM orchestration, strongly aligned with offload and serving-system lineages.

candidates.title: FlashSandwich: A Hardware-Aware Hybrid SSM-Transformer Architecture with Optimized KV Cache Management for Efficient LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Combines a hardware-aware hybrid SSM/Transformer design with explicit KV-cache management, connecting architecture choices to memory-efficient inference.

candidates.title: STS: Efficient Sparse Attention with Speculative Token Sparsity
candidates.reason: Uses a smaller draft model to predict token importance for sparse attention in long-context inference, directly connecting speculative computation to attention-memory reduction.
